name: smwgraphics-castlevania-symphony-of-the-night-long-library-entrance
title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night - Long Library (Entrance)
description:
The gorgeous tileset from the Entrance of the Long Library of Castlevania Symphony of the Night. Includes tons of decorations to be used as layer 2. The main ground and lanterns are layer 1. It can fit library pretty well. Can be used as HUB area, as well. I did my best to make it 1:1. Minimal color loss.

Heavy palette usage.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
